functions.name: task.approvals.listSignOffs
functions.description: Lists the instance's sign-offs, oldest first, one page at a time, the consumed ones included; with state, only those for it.

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

id.description: The key of the Task row the operation runs on.

limit.description: At most this many sign-offs; 50 when absent.

functions.name: task.approvals.signOff
functions.description: Signs off on the instance for a gated state, as the caller. Needs the permission of one of the gate's requirements, and is refused unless it counts toward one of them now: for the instance's creator unless the requirement allows it, for a caller the requirement does not count, excludes or whose proof falls short, while the instance is in the state, and for a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.

id.description: The key of the Task row the operation runs on.

state.description: The gated state to sign off for.

version.description: The row's version the signer read, the version a write through the core is held to. Needed on a pinned gate; on any gate, one that is not the row's version is vetoed stale before anything else is checked. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

functions.name: task.approvals.withdrawSignOff
functions.description: Withdraws the caller's sign-off for a gated state, one not yet consumed.

id.description: The key of the Task row the operation runs on.

state.description: The gated state whose sign-off to withdraw.

functions.name: task.status.transition
functions.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the caller read the instance in. An instance in another state refuses the move as the veto stale, before anything else is checked, so a retry that finds its move made is stale with the state it moved to. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

id.description: The key of the Task row the operation runs on.
